title: Submerged Utility Pole during Rural Flood, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot capturing a severe rural flood scene. The landscape is entirely inundated with water, partially submerging power poles, trees, and large floating storage tanks in the foreground. The overcast sky reflects off the floodwaters, documenting environmental impacts and infrastructure damage during a mid-20th-century natural disaster.
